request.intent:
The helpers in `lib/utils.js` have been reduced to naive implementations that no longer honour
their contract. Reimplement them, keeping every current export and signature:
- `basename(path, { windows })` returns the last non-empty segment, treats a backslash as a
  separator only when `windows` is set, and returns the last real segment when the path ends in
  a separator;
- `escapeLast(input, char, lastIdx)` escapes the last occurrence of `char` at or before `lastIdx`,
  but skips an occurrence that is already escaped and continues searching leftwards;
- `removePrefix(input, state)` strips a single leading './' and records it as `state.prefix`,
  leaves `state` untouched when there was no prefix, and still works when `state` is omitted.

The other helpers already behave correctly and must keep doing so. The wider library must be
unaffected, including `matchBase`, which routes through `basename`.
